Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

Compare now requests grouped and ungrouped report views per scale and derives display tables from them, but ResultSummary still publicly carries scales, grandD, group means, pairedN and range scalars. The requested removal/migration is incomplete.

Evidence:
- studio/app/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/compare/CompareSummary.scala:44 defines RequestReport and :163 accepts keyed replies
- studio/app/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/compare/CompareSummaryVM.scala:169 builds ScaleProfile from ReportView
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/backend/Views.scala:405-420 retains all legacy scale-bound ResultSummary scalars

Remaining / next action: Remove/migrate ResultSummary scalar consumers and version the protocol as specified.

Disposition: Keep open.
